target.name: M. tuberculosis InhA Reductase
target.domain_rationale: Non-kinase SDR enoyl-ACP reductase fold (sparsely represented in BindingDB_Kd relative to kinases); flagged high uncertainty and requires orthogonal docking/assay validation.
target.disease_burden: Isoniazid-resistant TB (katG/inhA mutations) affects >1M patients annually, requiring direct InhA inhibitors.
target.target_biology: Essential FAS-II mycolic acid biosynthesis reductase; clinical target of activated Isoniazid and Ethionamide.
target.reference_note: Known clinical TB drugs (Isoniazid prodrug, Ethionamide) are tagged to transparently illustrate non-kinase domain shift.
